violated_contract: The maximum live-episode span applies to speech from every member conversation. A same-conversation fast path or a multi-conversation episode must not keep the occasion open beyond the cap.
canonical_prevention: Check the episode's original start against every continued member's speech before accepting it. At or beyond the cap, close the old episode and open a new one for continued speech while preserving transcript receipt cursors. Prove the exact-cap boundary with a multi-conversation service test that verifies old notes remain and new speech lands in the new episode.
